risks.reason: Microsoft.Insights/diagnosticSettings has only three API versions (2016-09-01, 2017-05-01-preview, 2021-05-01-preview); 2021-05-01-preview is the newest and the only one with logAnalyticsDestinationType Dedicated, which the resource-specific Container Apps log tables need. The linter would accept only the 2016 version. Revisit when Microsoft publishes a newer version.
Single region by design: the demo keeps everything in UAE North (data residency, one resource group) and a cross-region workspace replica adds cost for no demo need.
Zone redundancy needs a VNet-integrated environment; Stage 1 is the Consumption profile only with no VNet, no private endpoint and max one replica per app.
The web app must be reachable from the internet for the judges; the api is internal-only (externalIngress false in main.bicep). Network isolation of the whole environment is Stage 2.
Geo-redundant backup copies the data to the paired region; Stage 1 keeps all data in UAE North (ADR 0001: single region, data residency) and the Burstable B1MS server is the decided tier.
Stage 1 uses one administrator password (64 hex) that exists only in Container Apps secrets (main.bicep); a Microsoft Entra administrator and managed-identity database access are Stage 2 hardening.
Same decision as Azure.PostgreSQL.AAD: password authentication stays on for Stage 1 because the asyncpg URL carries the password; Entra-only authentication is Stage 2.
Burstable B1MS is the decided tier (ADR 0001) and the Burstable tier does not offer zone-redundant high availability; HA is a Stage 2 pilot requirement.

Azure chooses the PostgreSQL maintenance window and the demo tolerates the restart; a custom window is a pilot requirement. (ADR 0001 rules out the Container Apps planned-maintenance window because of its USD 0.10/h meter: a different resource.)
api ingress is internal to the environment (externalIngress false), so only web in the same environment can reach it; per-IP rules add nothing.
web is public by design for the judges (0.0.0.0/0 is the requirement).
ADR 0001: min replicas 1, max 1 during 20 Nov-11 Dec: in-process state stays coherent and the numba warm-up cost is paid once.
ADR 0001: min replicas 1, max 1 during 20 Nov-11 Dec to keep the demo inside the idle-billing envelope.
The alerts worker is a single long-running loop; a second replica would duplicate every alert delivery, so exactly one replica is intended.
Geo-replication is a Premium-only feature; Basic is enough for two images pulled from one region, and replication would copy images out of UAE North.
Basic SKU is deliberate for the demo: two small images, one region, cost-minimal; Standard/Premium add throughput and features (replication, private link, quarantine) the demo does not use.

Microsoft documents that disabling export needs a Premium registry with a private endpoint (data-loss-prevention page); ADR 0001 rules out private endpoints in Stage 1. The admin user and anonymous pull are already off in bootstrap-rg.bicep.
Registry image scanning is Microsoft Defender for Containers, a paid plan enabled at subscription level and outside this template; no Stage 1 decision includes it.

Quarantine is a Premium-only registry feature; the demo registry is Basic, with the admin user and anonymous pull off (bootstrap-rg.bicep) and only the pull identity and the deployer able to reach images.

Container Apps pulls from the registry over its public endpoint and Stage 1 has no private endpoint or VNet (ADR 0001); access is limited to the pull identity (AcrPull) with the admin user and anonymous pull disabled.

libgomp1 is installed from the Debian archive of a base image that is pinned by digest, so the package version is fixed by that digest and a hand-pinned apt version would only break when the digest is bumped.
USER node is the official node image account (uid 1000 in /etc/passwd); no orchestrator here rejects a named user and libraries that look the uid up need the passwd entry.
